content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_00098 If the input parameters of StartScheduleTableRel are valid and the state of ScheduleTable <ScheduleTableID> is SCHEDULETABLE_STOPPED , then StartScheduleTableRel shall start the processing of a ScheduleTable <Sched- uleTableID>. The Initial Expiry Point shall be processed after <Offset> + Initial Offset ticks have elapsed on the underlying Counter . The state of <ScheduleTableID> is set to SCHEDULETABLE_RUNNING before the service returns to the caller.
